description: This file contains frontend test specifications for a React application, specifically testing additional branches and behaviors in App.js including theme toggling, export path logging, and audit error prefixing.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by clearing local storage before each test.

methods.name: test('theme toggle persists to localStorage and updates aria-label')
methods.description: Tests the theme toggle button for persisted state in localStorage and ARIA label updates.

methods.name: test('audit export path logs event and appends READ AuditTrail record')
methods.description: Verifies that exporting the audit path logs an event and doesn't crash, simulating user interaction.

methods.name: test('making an invalid move logs a single-prefixed error in audit panel')
methods.description: Checks that invalid moves produce an error with correct single prefix in the audit trail panel.
